milestone: synthetic premise check before any real waveform contract review
decision_it_changes: whether the current post-filter support boundary has a demonstrated synthetic cross-row exposure worth carrying into a separately reviewed real-waveform contract
cheapest_adequate_test: one deterministic CPU fixture through the exact reviewed production wrapper and native Kilosort centering/CAR/high-pass path
completion_condition: all frozen controls and the transition comparison execute once from bound source and emit an immutable result packet and H5 review request

geometry_receipt.label: completed production B384 physical geometry receipt

production_field.label: production displacement field establishing observed 40-um lattice states

fixture.whitening: 384-by-384 float32 identity to isolate the pre-whitening boundary
fixture.state_clock: synthetic global sample clock; half-open transition at frame 1024
fixture.base_signal: int16 channel-index gradient multiplied by fixed 900-Hz plus 1800-Hz integer carrier; this gives the four soon-unsupported rows leverage on the native median CAR

unsupported_perturbation.purpose: active step on physically unsupported rows after the transition; chosen before outputs to cross the median rank under the deterministic gradient and exercise centering, CAR, and high-pass

supported_waveform.expectation: independently injected valid activity must remain visibly nonzero after the actual operator; the production support helper is not used as its oracle

measurement.note: the transition is 1024 samples from the raw-file start and 61 padded samples are retained; the measurement covers the fixed local transition neighborhood

cases.role: cross-row negative control; native high-pass remains active but per-channel

competing_predictions.safe_current_boundary: T1 minus T0 is numerically zero on supported rows after post-filter masking; the source-map premise is falsified
competing_predictions.cross_row_exposure: T1 minus T0 is nonzero on supported rows while T0/T0R agree, A1 proves stimulus activity, N1/N0 remain zero without CAR, and the independent supported waveform survives
competing_predictions.indeterminate: controls fail or the transition effect falls between frozen thresholds; no advance

decision_semantics.PREMISE_SURVIVES_CURRENT_BOUNDARY_CROSS_: permit review, but not execution, of an H5 real-waveform contract only if H5 independently establishes real support-boundary exposure
decision_semantics.INVALID_FIXTURE_CONTROL_FAILURE: repair the fixture under a new version without interpreting the premise
decision_semantics.INDETERMINATE_NO_ADVANCE: stop pending a separately justified frozen discriminator

prohibitions: training, sorting, clustering, or template fitting
